description: This file contains the server-side logic for the MCQExam page in an online examination system. It handles loading questions from a database, managing session data, timing the exam, and submitting answers to record the user's score.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for managing the MCQ exam page, including question loading, session handling, timing, and answer submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial loading of questions from the database based on the selected course, and initializes the timer.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the User Profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates the user's score based on selected answers, records the result in the database, and navigates to the results page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by transferring to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display and handles exam timeout when time expires.
